svg.text: campaign returns a buffered response on the gateway: it
returns only once elected, so timeout bounds the wait;
proclaim/resign need the full leader descriptor (name/key/rev)
— with a field missing etcd answers 200 and does nothing.

svg.text: mutual exclusion comes from campaign + lease; if the holder
is SIGKILLed the lock is released when the lease expires,
Every failure raises a typed exception from Erikwang2013\Etcd\Exception; the HTTP and gRPC transports share one subsystem API.
